t: The Attorney General is authorized to extend through September 30, 2007, the Personnel Management Demonstration Project transferred to the Attorney General pursuant to section 1115 of the Homeland Security Act of 2002, Public Law 107–296 (6 U.S.C. 533) without limitation on the number of employees or the positions covered.

fable.w: The section only authorizes the Attorney General to extend an internal federal personnel demonstration project covering federal employees. A tempting reading is that a "demonstration project" implies outside involvement, but no consultation, rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government is provided.
fable.s: The Attorney General is authorized to extend through September 30, 2007, the Personnel Management Demonstration Project

qwen_block.w: This section authorizes a federal official (the Attorney General) to extend an internal personnel management demonstration project. It does not involve consultation, coordination, or participation with any parties outside the federal government, such as the public, states, or private entities. The actors involved are entirely within the executive branch.
